steps.title: Conga line
steps.rule: Go to 2m south-west of the centre.

RegenHealer.rule: Go to 9m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Go to 9m east of the centre.

MeleeDpsB.rule: Go to 4m south-east of the centre.

PhysRangedDps.rule: Go to 6m east of the centre.

CasterDps.rule: Go to 6m west of the centre.

steps.title: Attack dodge
steps.cue: A tether lands on another player
steps.rule: Read the strat's AttackDodge: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: AttackDir).

steps.title: Spread positions
steps.rule: Read the strat's SpreadPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NewNorthA).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's SpreadPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: AttackDir).

CasterDps.rule: Read the strat's SpreadPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: AttackDir).

steps.title: Knockback positions

MainTank.rule: Read the strat's KnockbackPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: Order).

OffTank.rule: Read the strat's KnockbackPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: AttackDir).

RegenHealer.rule: Go to 3m west of the centre.

ShieldHealer.rule: Read the strat's KnockbackPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: Glitch).

MeleeDpsA.rule: Read the strat's KnockbackPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: Glitch).

PhysRangedDps.rule: Read the strat's StackPositions: the spot follows a rule the rolls alone don't show (closest roll: NewNorthA).
